why: Two August 2026 arXiv preprints (2608.23281, 2608.24750) present a deterministic sin^2-type algorithm for complex cubic irrationalities (Karpenkov's signature (1,1) case, the last open case for n=3) with exact periodicity certificates verified on 205 sample polynomials and an exhaustive box search, extending the totally-real case solved earlier by Karpenkov (2022, pre-snapshot).
